_note: Dashboard-maintained reference: who/what each Capital Flow entity is + an official link. Keyed by node id from capitalMap.json. alloc:BlackRock.description: World's largest asset manager (~$12T AUM); its infrastructure arm (GIP) is a lead financier of AI data-center and power buildout.

alloc:SoftBank.description: Japanese holding/investment group behind the Vision Funds; a lead backer of OpenAI and large AI-infrastructure bets.

alloc:Blackstone.description: Largest alternative-asset manager; deploys real-estate and infrastructure capital into data centers and digital infrastructure.

alloc:Brookfield.description: Global alternative-asset manager focused on infrastructure, real assets and renewable power — key to AI data-center and energy finance.

alloc:Meta.description: Meta Platforms — hyperscaler deploying balance-sheet capital into AI compute, data centers and model development.

alloc:NVIDIA.description: Dominant AI-accelerator maker; also a strategic investor taking stakes across the AI-compute and neocloud stack.

alloc:Coatue.description: Technology-focused crossover investment manager active across late-stage AI and public tech.

alloc:Andreessen Horowitz.description: a16z — venture firm and one of the most active investors in AI startups across the stack.

alloc:Sequoia.description: Sequoia Capital — venture firm backing foundational AI and infrastructure companies.

alloc:Khosla Ventures.description: Venture firm; early OpenAI backer and active across frontier AI and deep tech.

alloc:Altimeter.description: Altimeter Capital — technology-focused public/private crossover investment firm.

alloc:Blue Owl.description: Blue Owl Capital — alternative-asset manager active in digital-infrastructure and data-center financing.

alloc:DigitalBridge.description: Digital-infrastructure investment manager (data centers, towers, fiber) central to AI-buildout capital.

alloc:Galaxy Digital.description: Digital-asset and data-center company converting crypto-mining sites (e.g. Helios, TX) into AI/HPC capacity.

alloc:Peter Thiel.description: Co-founder of PayPal and Palantir; founder of Founders Fund. Long-horizon backer of frontier tech.

alloc:Jeff Bezos.description: Founder of Amazon and Blue Origin; invests personally via Bezos Expeditions.

alloc:Reid Hoffman.description: Co-founder of LinkedIn and Inflection AI; partner at Greylock. Prolific AI angel investor.

alloc:Elad Gil.description: Serial entrepreneur and prolific angel/solo-GP investor in AI startups; author of the High Growth Handbook.

alloc:Garry Tan.description: President & CEO of Y Combinator; founder of Initialized Capital.

alloc:Eric Schmidt.description: Former Google/Alphabet CEO & chairman; funds science and AI/defense via Schmidt Sciences and Schmidt Futures.

alloc:Stanley Druckenmiller.description: Legendary macro investor; runs the Duquesne Family Office.

target:OpenAI.description: Frontier AI lab behind ChatGPT and the GPT models; among the most heavily capitalized private AI companies.

target:Safe Superintelligence.description: SSI — AI lab founded by Ilya Sutskever focused solely on building safe superintelligence.

target:Databricks.description: Data + AI platform (lakehouse) used to build and serve AI/ML at enterprise scale.

target:Bloom Energy.description: Public maker of solid-oxide fuel cells providing on-site power for data centers.

target:QTS Realty Trust.description: Hyperscale data-center operator (Blackstone-owned) building large AI-ready campuses.

target:Etched.description: Startup building transformer-specialized inference ASICs (Sohu) for large language models.

target:Valar Atomics.description: Nuclear-energy startup developing small modular reactors to power compute and industry.

target:Aligned Data Centers.description: Hyperscale/colo data-center developer-operator building AI-ready capacity across the Americas.

target:Japan AI data centers.description: SoftBank-led AI data-center buildout in Japan (including a former Sharp LCD plant in Osaka converted for OpenAI-agent workloads), part of the Stargate Japan effort.

target:Meta El Paso data center JV (Proj.description: ~$14B El Paso, Texas data-center campus (codename Project Sopaipilla) developed via a Meta–BlackRock venture; BlackRock-managed funds hold 80% and Meta 20%, with Meta as sole occupant of the 1GW site.

target:Meta-BlackRock El Paso data cente.description: The Meta–BlackRock joint venture (Project Sopaipilla) owning and developing the ~$14B, 1GW El Paso, Texas AI data-center campus, financed partly via $12.5B of Sopaipilla notes.

target:Coatue Retail Fund.description: Coatue's first retail-oriented crossover vehicle (Coatue Innovative Strategies Fund), investing in public tech and late-stage AI/private companies; raised ~$8B.

target:Founders Fund Growth Fund IV.description: Founders Fund's fourth late-stage growth fund (~$6B), the firm's largest, backing late-stage tech and AI companies.

target:Galaxy Helios Data Centers II (Di.description: Expansion phase of Galaxy Digital's Helios campus in Dickens County, West Texas — a former crypto-mining site converted to a multi-gigawatt AI/HPC data center anchored by CoreWeave.

target:Thrive Holdings.description: Holding company launched by Josh Kushner's Thrive Capital that acquires traditional services firms (IT, accounting) and rewires them with AI; OpenAI holds a strategic stake.

target:Atoms.description: Industrial-robotics company from Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick (rebranded from City Storage Systems), building 'gainfully employed' robots for food, mining and transport; raised $1.7B led by a16z.

target:Cathedral.description: Defense/cyber startup founded by former DOGE staffers building AI-powered military cyber capabilities; backed by a16z and Sequoia.

target:Norm Ai.description: New York startup that converts regulations and policies into compliance AI agents for regulated enterprises.

target:Panthalassa.description: Startup building self-propelled, wave-powered floating platforms (Ocean-3) to run AI compute at sea; backed by Peter Thiel.

target:Flourish.description: AI startup building a brain-inspired, energy-efficient computing architecture (Cortex AI); founded by Rob Williams and neuroscientist Thomas Reardon, backed by Jeff Bezos, Lux Capital and GV.

target:Kirkwood Infrastructure Group.description: Fiber and conduit infrastructure platform launched by Blue Owl's Digital Infrastructure strategy to build the connectivity backbone for AI-era data centers.

target:Nippon Gateway Infrastructure.description: Japanese colocation data-center platform formed by DigitalBridge and JEXI, launched with NEC data-center assets in Greater Tokyo and Osaka.

target:Odyssey.description: AI research company building real-time world models, founded by self-driving veterans Oliver Cameron and Jeff Hawke.

target:Monogram.description: AI startup from Udemy/Carbon Health founder Eren Bali building a general-purpose AI app that generates interactive visual UIs rather than chat; raised a $40M seed.

target:General Intuition.description: AI research lab spun out of gaming-clip platform Medal, training agents for spatial-temporal reasoning on gameplay data; led by Pim de Witte.

target:CuspAI.description: Cambridge, UK AI-driven materials-discovery startup co-founded by Chad Edwards and Prof. Max Welling; backs an 'AI Materials Foundry'.

target:Prometheus.description: Project Prometheus — heavily capitalized, stealth AI company from Jeff Bezos and Vik Bajaj building models that understand the physical world for industrial robotics.

target:Generalist AI.description: San Francisco robotics-AI company building hardware-agnostic embodied foundation models (GEN-1) for dexterous manipulation.

target:Prentis.description: AI research lab building computer-use models/agents that operate software across browser, desktop and mobile; co-founded by Ritankar Das with Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus.
